about_the_game:
In the game, you'll play as the Harry and Larry brothers, two twin 9-year-old's who are on their quest to complete the annual Grocery Run event and win its grand prize.

PUT YOUR REFLEXES TO THE TEST

• Fly through 28 colorful grocery aisle levels that get progressively faster and harder.

• Dodge hazardous obstacles scattered throughout including fish crates, ladders, snowballs, and more - this isn't your ordinary grocery store outing!

• Collect tasty treats such as fruit, candy, and, yes, even vegetables because Mom said we need more fiber in our diet.

FIGHT DEVIOUS BOSS BATTLES

• Wear out the giant robotic fish before it gobbles you up!

• Face off against the disgruntled store clerk trying to hose you down with a high-pressure spray of Jim's Crazy Cola.

• And more, just waiting for you at the end of each section!

DISCOVER NEW ABILITIES

• Get temporary invincibility and knock back those pesky fish crates.

• Grab a shield for one-time protection against hazards.

• Bounce off bumpers to reach extra treats.

• Fly through speed-up and speed-down chambers to change your speed (and the music tempo).

SIMPLE CONTROLS

• Use your mouse to move Harry and Larry up and down, while they automatically fly forward.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit) *
  • Processor: 1.4GHz CPU or faster
  • Memory: 1 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Graphics card supporting OpenGL 2
  • Storage: 256 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: * Windows 10 (32-bit) is not supported.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: 1.4GHz CPU or faster
  • Memory: 1 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Graphics card supporting OpenGL 2 and MSAA 4x
  • Storage: 256 MB available space

short_description: Grocery Run is a fast-paced obstacle course game filled with cartoon action and comedy. Test your reflexes as you collect tasty treats and dodge hazardous obstacles. Defeat devious bosses and discover what lurks inside the mysterious Employees Only section - you know you've always wondered!
